# new-build-context

Ten used-good RTX 3090 asks (£600 to £690) and ten new ones (£800 to £890). Each used position keeps
the new group's median (£845) and n as context, since that group has n >= 10; the new positions
carry none. The context is internal (v_positions) until the owner says how it is worded
(docs/questions/asking-price-position.md).
